info.title: x-ui panel API
info.description:
The JSON API behind the x-ui panel, the same one the web UI calls.

**Base URL.** Every path below is relative to the panel's own base path. With a panel on `https://example.com:2053/mypanel/`, the inbound list is at `https://example.com:2053/mypanel/xui/API/inbounds/`.

**Authentication.** Post your credentials to `{basePath}login`, keep the `x-ui` cookie it returns and send it with every later call. There is no API token.

**Errors.** Almost every endpoint answers HTTP 200 with `{success, msg, obj}`; check `success` rather than the status code. Only an unauthenticated request returns 401.

basePath.description: the panel base path, with leading and trailing slashes

post.summary: Log in and receive the session cookie
post.description: Every other endpoint requires the `x-ui` cookie this returns. Send the credentials as a form post or JSON and keep the cookie for subsequent calls. Note this path sits directly under the panel base path, not under the API group.
